race.comment: TOWN PLANNER (8) was far too good on debut at Swan Hill over 1600m, and with missing a couple of grades to be here, he will carry the same weight. He has had a jump-out since then, and looks to have plenty of upside. Hard to beat again. SECOND FIX (7) improved to finish runner-up at Naracoorte a fortnight ago, in just his second start from the Holly McKechnie stable. He will be peaking for this, and can figure in the top 4 again. PANDA'S SPECTRUM (5) needed his resuming run at Pakenham just over 2 weeks ago, and she gets better with racing. She may already want more ground than a mile, but she can still run on into a placing here. BRUNG KING (1) ran a much better race when fifth at Bendigo last time out, and he is capable of a top 4 finish in this.
